description: Build an unsigned transaction that sends SOL, or a higher.fun coin, from a wallet to another wallet. It has no sign_url: highwire.fun's sign page never signs transfers, since a link can come from anyone. Sign it with your own wallet tooling, or use execute_transfer with the local signer, which only sends to the policy's allowlist.

mint.description: A higher.fun coin to send instead of SOL.

sol.description: SOL to send. Give this, or mint and tokens.

to.description: The recipient's wallet. It must be on the policy's transfer_allowlist.

wallet.description: The wallet that sends and pays (public key only).

name: build_transfer
title: Build a transfer (unsigned)
